stories.headline: GTA VI launches with $1.65B estimated pre-launch revenue, record 99 Metacritic and 30fps on consoles

key_facts.fact: Sensor Tower estimates GTA VI had generated $1.65 billion in revenue and 17.07 million units sold before its official launch.
key_facts.excerpt: Sensor Tower estima US$ 1,65 bilhão em receita do GTA VI, com 17,07 milhões de unidades vendidas antes do lançamento oficial.

key_facts.fact: Players are changing their console region to New Zealand, 16 hours ahead of Brazil, to access GTA VI before the official Nov. 19 launch.
key_facts.excerpt: Com a Nova Zelândia 16 horas à frente do Brasil, jogadores alteram a região do console e acessam o jogo antes do lançamento oficial de 19/11.

key_facts.fact: GTA VI hit 99/100 on Metacritic and 98/100 on OpenCritic, a record for both, with IGN and GameSpot giving perfect scores; Take-Two shares jumped more than 6%.
key_facts.excerpt: Rockstar's GTA VI hits a 99/100 rating on Metacritic and 98/100 on OpenCritic, a record for both, as IGN and GameSpot give it perfect scores; TTWO jumps 6%+ (Jason Schreier/Bloomberg)

key_facts.fact: Rockstar says GTA VI targets 30fps across all current-gen consoles; PS5 and Xbox Series X upscale from 1440p to 4K and Xbox Series S from 720p to 1080p.
key_facts.excerpt: Rockstar says GTA VI targets 30fps across all current-gen consoles; PS5 and Xbox Series X upscale the game from 1440p to 4K and Xbox Series S from 720p to 1080p (Alessio Palumbo/Wccftech)

key_facts.fact: Sony warned that GTA 6 will not open on the PS5 without a 1.3 GB anti-piracy update.
key_facts.excerpt: Sony avisa: GTA 6 não vai abrir no PS5 sem atualização antipirataria de 1,3 GB

stories.headline: House Democrats nominate Hakeem Jeffries for speaker; floor vote set for Jan. 3, 2027

key_facts.fact: House Democrats formally nominated Hakeem Jeffries for speaker on Nov. 18.
key_facts.excerpt: House Democrats formally nominate Hakeem Jeffries for speaker

key_facts.fact: The internal Democratic vote gave Jeffries 251 votes; the floor election for speaker is scheduled for Jan. 3, 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: Votação interna do Partido Democrata deu 251 votos a Hakeem Jeffries para presidente da Câmara; eleição no plenário está marcada para 3 de janeiro de 2027.

key_facts.fact: If elected, Jeffries would be the first Black House speaker; the Guardian says the nomination came despite concerns from progressives.
key_facts.excerpt: Democrats nominate Hakeem Jeffries as first Black House speaker despite progressives' concerns

key_facts.fact: Axios frames the nomination as a shift of power in Congress.
key_facts.excerpt: Jeffries nears historic speakership as power shifts in Congress

stories.headline: Hegseth visits Caracas as US and Venezuela sign military cooperation deal

key_facts.fact: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth met Delcy Rodriguez in Caracas and the two countries signed a military cooperation agreement that includes training and intelligence sharing.
key_facts.excerpt: Pete Hegseth se reuniu com Delcy Rodríguez em Caracas e os dois países assinaram acordo de cooperação militar, incluindo treinamento e compartilhamento de inteligência.

key_facts.fact: SCMP describes the deal as re-establishing military ties between the US and Venezuela.
key_facts.excerpt: US and Venezuela sign deal to re-establish military ties during Hegseth visit

key_facts.fact: The Financial Times reports the two countries will expand military co-operation to target drug trafficking.
key_facts.excerpt: US and Venezuela to expand military co-operation to target drug trafficking

key_facts.fact: Times Brasil reports Hegseth announced the cooperation with Venezuela's interim government.
key_facts.excerpt: Secretário da Guerra de Trump visita Venezuela e anuncia acordo de cooperação militar com governo interino

key_facts.fact: After the surprise Venezuela visit, the Pentagon chief was to hand over a military aircraft to Colombia on Thursday, Nov. 19.

stories.headline: Google DeepMind releases Genie 4 world model in Project Genie for AI Ultra subscribers

key_facts.excerpt: Genie 4 is now available in Project Genie.

stories.headline: Ukraine hits the Crimea Bridge a third time this week; Russia says rebuilding could take years

key_facts.excerpt: Um terceiro ataque atingiu a ponte que liga a Rússia à Crimeia, e o tráfego foi suspenso enquanto equipes avaliam os danos, às vésperas de um encontro entre Putin, Trump e Xi.

key_facts.fact: G1 reports Ukraine attacked the Crimea bridge for the third time in the week while Putin was meeting Trump and Xi.
key_facts.excerpt: Enquanto Putin se reúne com Trump e Xi, Ucrânia ataca ponte da Crimeia pela terceira vez na semana

key_facts.fact: BBC published video showing explosions moments before part of the Crimea Bridge collapsed.

stories.headline: DNI, DHS and FBI tell Congress no evidence US outages were linked or caused by cyberattacks
